body.x: NUEVUE(www.nuevue.com) unveiled iPhone protective case 'NUEVUE' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

This case is Anti-microbial protection eliminates up to 99% of bacteria on screen’s surface, and protecting devices safety. Cases are lined with the highest - grade microfibers. Available in cotton twill, leather & canvas and in a variety of stylish colors to iPhone, iPad, iPad Mini.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
